cloud speech to text now lets you choose among different recognition models for transcription requests including a model optimized for transcribing audio from video files
cloud speech to text now supports returning begin and end timestamps for each recognized word when the enablewordtimeoffsets request parameter is enabled
cloud speech to text expanded support for the ogg opus audio encoding to include 8 000 hz 12 000 hz 16 000 hz 24 000 hz and 48 000 hz input sample rates
cloud speech to text introduced data logging for general use allowing google to log data to help reduce usage costs by improving the service
speech to text now supports model adaptation by allowing users to create custom classes and phrase sets to improve transcription quality
speech to text launched the chirp telephony model a telephony focused fine tuned usm based model for phone call audio sampled at 8 khz
cloud speech to text now supports including additional audio source metadata in transcription requests to improve recognition results
cloud speech to text allows users to select different speech recognition models including a model optimized for video file audio
makes speaker diarization available on latest models for en us enabling recognition of multiple speakers in the same audio clip
cloud speech to text supports including recognition metadata with transcription requests to improve speech recognition results
cloud speech to text can automatically detect the language in an audio file when multiple alternative languages are provided
introduces the telephony short model for phone call audio recognition as an updated variant of the existing phone call model
cloud speech to text added support for seven new languages burmese estonian uzbek punjabi albanian macedonian and mongolian
cloud speech to text now supports speech adaptation by allowing users to supply hints that influence speech recognition
introduces the telephony model for recognizing phone call audio using the latest version of the legacy phone call model
the cloud speech to text v1beta api version is no longer available and users are required to migrate to v1 or v1p1beta1
speech to text introduced medical speech recognition models optimized for vocabulary commonly used in medical settings
cloud speech to text added support for streaming recognition sessions up to 5 minutes available via the v1p1beta1 api
speech to text launched the on prem api to enable integration of google speech recognition into on premises solutions
cloud speech to text can insert punctuation such as commas periods and question marks into transcription results
speech to text now allows long running transcription results to be uploaded directly to a cloud storage bucket
the chirp 3 transcription model introduced speaker diarization support to identify different speakers in audio
the chirp 2 model added support for streaming recognizer requests in addition to sync and batch recognition
the chirp 2 model became generally available in the asia southeast1 us central1 and europe west4 regions
cloud speech to text added the enhanced telephony model feature for additional supported languages
cloud speech to text added the speech adaptation boost feature for additional supported languages
cloud speech to text provides endless streaming support for transcribing an infinite audio stream
speech to text now includes substantially improved recognition quality for the latest short model
cloud speech to text can use enhanced speech recognition models to improve transcription quality
